updateTo.name: Juno 0.1.12-beta.2
updateTo.notes:
# Draft here fills in applications, and your team can reach your cloud computer

## Draft here

- One-line fields too. Draft here now fills a form's Name, Email and other single-line fields, not only reply boxes.
- Long application answers in your voice. A "Why do you want to work here?" box is answered from its own question, with the job posting and your resume in hand, on the strongest model, in your words and with your facts. There is no fixed length: the answer is as long as the question needs, and it is never cut short.
- All or nothing. A draft goes into the page whole, as one paste, or not at all, so you never get half an answer.
- Only you stop it. Juno keeps typing until it is done; only a real move of your pointer stops it, not a window that took focus on its own.
- Forms read correctly on Ashby and pages like it, so each long box gets the answer to its own question. When Juno is unsure what a page holds, it takes a look at the screen before it writes.
- A reply in a chat no longer takes the other person's promise as yours.
- The notch shows each app's own icon (WhatsApp, Slack and the rest) instead of a grey letter.
- The notch card that stayed open after a Draft here line now closes when your pointer leaves it.

## Teams

- Your cloud computer takes over when your Mac is away. A teammate's ask that needs your Mac, while it is off, moves to your cloud computer, and the room says so at once: "Kinjal's Mac is away. Running on Kinjal's cloud computer."
- Your cloud computer in Settings: watch it live, click, type and scroll in it, open Gmail or Google Calendar there to sign in, then Take control and Hand back.
- Needs you takes you to the first OK card waiting for you in the chat and marks it.
- The OK card shows the answer the way the room will show it, with its formatting, never raw ** marks. Edit still edits the exact words.
- Sources and OKs name people by their full name.
- Every Share, Keep private and edited Share is a line in the team's audit ledger (who, which ask, how; never the words).
- Posting in the room is faster: a message appears as soon as it is saved, and the team is told after.
- Asking your own Juno never asks you for permission. A card says where its answer was made, on your Mac or your cloud computer.

## Updates

- The browser stays on Chromium 157 (157.0.8103.50, the same security-fixed version as 0.1.11).
- Every tab, the sidebar and the chat's Chat | Page switch show the site's own icon, never a grey letter.
- The docked card is the composer's exact width, with no edges sticking out past it.
- Home's picture fills the window again, under the tab strip.
- A chat's tab group is named after the chat alone, without " · Chats" after it, and a tab that never loaded a page stays out of it.

## Fixes

- Memory no longer saves an account you used for one task as your applications email, and one source never replaces what several others said.
- A sign-in through a passkey on your phone has 15 minutes to finish, not 5.

## Not in this beta

- Teams is still a research preview: it appears only for accounts it has been opened to. Ask us if you want your team in.
- The cloud computer is switched on from our side, account by account.
- Juno needs a Mac with Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. It downloads about 640 MB of speech models the first time you use your voice.
updateTo.summary: Draft here writes long application answers in your voice and fills one-line fields; Teams can run asks on your cloud computer.
